subcategory_text: Information on adverse events is provided to authorized staff and tools
implementation_examples: Use cybersecurity software to generate alerts and provide them to the security operations center (SOC), incident responders, and incident response tools
Incident responders and other authorized personnel can access log analysis findings at all times
Automatically create and assign tickets in the organization's ticketing system when certain types of alerts occur
Manually create and assign tickets in the organization's ticketing system when technical staff discover indicators of compromise
assessment_objectives: Determine whether information on adverse events is provided to authorized staff and tools.
Determine whether activities are conducted to use cybersecurity software to generate alerts and provide them to the security operations center (SOC), incident responders, and incident response tools.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that incident responders and other authorized personnel can access log analysis findings at all times.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
